title: Rolling aerobic, tired legs
coachNotes:
EXECUTION: trailhead by 07:30, no pre-ride. 1h50 at 144-152bpm, ~450m D+. Run the climbs at easy effort, no surges; cadence 172+ on the descents.
GYM: none.
FUEL: 1 flask Tailwind (500ml, 2 scoops), 1 gel at 1h00.
GARMIN: ~120-140.
STOP RULE: HRV under 50 = 1h10. Quads wrecked after Sat = 1h20 flat at the same HR.
WHY: Sun 18 booked 52% of plan (1h24 at 136bpm after a pre-ride); the VWT back-half stimulus needs the full 1h50 in band (+10 vs old plan).
